title: WEATHER FORECAST FOR 05 MARCH 2026 Issued at 05.30 a.m. on 05 March 2026. Showers or thundershowers are likely at a few places in Uva and Sabaragamuwa provinces and in Hambantota, Nuwara-Eliya and Ampara districts after 2.00 p.m. Mainly dry weather will prevail over the other parts of the island. Misty conditions can be expected at some places in Western, Sabaragamuwa, Central, Southern, Uva, North-western and North-central provinces and in Mannar and Vavuniya districts during the early hours of the morning.
